I confirmed the figures against the records the route census names, as the task asked. THE $200: the packet says 'The circuit clerk charges the § 59-1-11(a)(1) civil-action filing fee, which the official text sets at $200.' The committed track registry's wv_conv_single_misdemeanor destination.detail says 'paying the § 59-1-11(a)(1) civil-action filing fee, which the official text sets at $200', the committed route census carries the same sentence on this route key, and the committed packet-set manifest's pay_fee entry says the same. Any relief from the $200 circuit clerk fee would be under the circuit court's ordinary civil indigency practice, which the controlling review did not establish.' A3 holds that a record establishes an answer only for the route it actually addresses, and that a line keyed to a different statutory section is a sibling-route inference A2 already forbids. Run on this route's fee fact — the circuit clerk's charge for a § 61-11-26 misdemeanour conviction expungement petition — the test comes out clean, and it shows the repair dodged a live trap of exactly A3's shape. THE RECORDS THAT DO ADDRESS THIS ROUTE: the track registry entry is keyed by trackId to this track, the route census entry is keyed by the full route key, and the packet-set manifest entry is keyed by packetSetId; all three carry the § 59-1-11(a)(1) $200 sentence for this route and nothing else. whyTheseAreNotRows.what: These eight refusals are recorded here and NOT appended to the rows array, deliberately.
whyTheseAreNotRows.why: extract-verifier-returns.mjs reads every entry in rows as a verdict ABOUT THE FAMILY and keeps one current verdict per family. Its supersedes() prefers a row whose declared verifiedAtBase is a descendant of the incumbent's. All eight of these families currently carry FAIL_REPAIR_REQUIRED at bases 7fcfb7d40aafe7bd7350fc735ea09d16524cb757, ebc44031ec7eab29058bfc79a7bc5e1cff089414 and 36d7718a7e48d7f87f18eeaf3b18ed9b3ce545c8; git merge-base --is-ancestor confirms each is an ancestor of this base. A row of mine declaring this base would therefore have superseded all eight.
whyTheseAreNotRows.measuredConsequence: The baseline sweep at this base reports 32 FAIL_REPAIR_REQUIRED families and names all eight of these among them. Appending these refusals as rows would have taken that list to 24 — eight known-failing families dropped off the repair queue on the strength of a read that never happened, replaced by a verdict that is a statement about this lane rather than about the packet.
whyTheseAreNotRows.therefore: A claim-gate refusal is not a verdict about a family and is not recorded as one. rows is left exactly as the previous lanes wrote it; nothing was superseded, upgraded, downgraded or removed.
whyTheseAreNotRows.aStructuralFindingForCaptain: The extractor has no way to say 'this lane could not look'. Its vocabulary contains BLOCKED_BEFORE_CLAIM and STOPPED, but any row carrying them still competes for the family's single current-verdict slot and still displaces an actionable FAIL. If refused lanes are expected to return rows, the extractor should exclude non-reading verdicts from supersession. Raised, not decided, and not repaired here: this lane may not edit factory scripts.
whyTheseAreNotRows.alsoChecked: All fifteen obligation names already appear in each of these four documents, so adding them here leaves unscoredObligations empty as it already was, and no other lane's PASS_COMPLETE_INDEPENDENT row changes its downgrade state.

This lane will not transfer a grant to itself: VF05, VF06 and VF08 are the lanes whose directories already hold a prior view of these very families, so a reissue in place would put the second read back in front of the same eyes the independence rule excludes.

fableVcAppend.whyThisReaderIsIndependent: FABLE-VC read this lane's grant at base 4f5af4e714ae19dacdf17304abcbac9a6d1ea0b7. It built none of the families it scored, repaired none of them, holds no PF or FIX lane in this dispatch, and had formed no prior view of any of them: no directory under data/rcap-grade-a/ carries a FABLE-VC row before this one. Every hash, page count, box measurement, obligation count and quotation in its rows was recomputed in its own container from the committed bytes and the mounted Master Library. Where a family already carried a verdict, that verdict was treated as evidence of nothing and the family was scored from zero — which mattered here, because all three families it could claim carried pre-repair FAILs recorded at bases this one descends from.
